## New Tools & Releases

- **Nvidia BioNeMo integration** — Claude Science ships with Nvidia's BioNeMo Agent Toolkit, reaching life-sci models Evo 2, Boltz-2, OpenFold3. [Northeastern](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/06/30/anthropic-claude-science-launch/)
- **Vercel "eve" agent framework** — Open-source "Next.js for agents": define agents as files, compiles to a production app on Vercel Functions with durable execution, sandboxes, approvals, subagents, evals. [JetBrains blog](https://blog.jetbrains.com/pycharm/2026/06/top-agentic-frameworks-for-building-applications-2026/)
